hero.title: What's Happening in Kanazawa This Weekend
hero.tagline: Use the weekend lens when atmosphere matters more than volume: what is happening this weekend, where the city feels strongest from Friday through Sunday, and how to let Kanazawa stay elegant instead of rushed.

page_context.label: Weekend planning guide
page_context.note: This weekend sits inside Kanazawa's spring walking window, which means the strongest planning tension is between giving the garden and old quarters enough time and keeping the schedule loose enough for tea, food, and district wandering.
page_context.next_refresh: Before the weekend of April 17 to 19, 2026

intro_html: Weekend Kanazawa is at its best when you let one evening and one long walking block define the trip. The city does not need a frantic pace; it needs good sequencing and enough room for the historic core to breathe. This page answers the direct short-break question: what is happening in Kanazawa this weekend, and what should you do differently because of it?

todos.title: Anchor one evening properly
todos.body: A market-led dinner, Katamachi night, or slower tea-and-district evening is enough. Kanazawa does not need three nightlife moves.

todos.title: Keep one afternoon open for whichever district clicks most
todos.body: The city's real payoff often comes from lingering longer than planned in Higashiyama or Nagamachi once the day has settled.

events.title: Start with a dinner-led Katamachi evening
events.description: Friday is best used to make Kanazawa feel inhabited rather than historic-only. Katamachi gives the city a looser, more local night than the preserved quarters do.

events.title: Use Saturday for the classic Kanazawa pairing
events.description: Saturday is strongest as one serious morning in Kenroku-en and the castle area, followed by a slower old-quarter stretch once the city feels more legible.

events.title: Let Sunday lean quieter and more selective
events.description: Sunday suits a more edited Kanazawa: one district with room for tea, one cultural stop if it still feels right, and enough slack that the city can stay graceful rather than scheduled.

getting_there.text: On spring weekends, the center is usually best handled on foot once you have reached the historic core.
Use the Loop Bus as a reset between the station and the core, not as the main way to spend the whole weekend.
